BiblicalUsage: The word is the Aramaic bed, and in Daniel it is where the visions come: the visions of thy head upon thy bed, the thoughts that came into the king's mind upon his bed, and the dream that troubled Nebuchadnezzar while he lay upon his bed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God speaks in the night: kings dream on their beds and cannot rest until Daniel tells them what the dreams mean.
